tags.name: Business profiles
tags.description: The site's shared business profiles, which blogs show as schema.org data (site admins).

tags.name: Site administration
tags.description: Site-wide administration (site admins): user accounts, revision retention, runtime properties.

tags.name: Comments
tags.description: Readers' comments on a weblog's entries: read, moderate, delete and reply.

tags.name: Contact messages
tags.description: The weblog's contact-form inbox (session only: the admin app, never a token).

tags.name: Entry trash
tags.description: An entry in the trash: restore it as a draft, or delete it forever. Needs publish rights, as the Trash page does.

tags.name: Weblog themes
tags.description: The shared themes a weblog may switch to, and the switch to its own templates (a custom theme).

tags.name: Site tokens
tags.description: Every token on the site (session only: the admin app, never a token).

tags.name: Pages
tags.description: A weblog's pages: write, trash and restore them, their revisions, and a strand's parts.

tags.name: Weblog settings
tags.description: A weblog's settings and theme, for its owner.

tags.name: Tokens
tags.description: Minting, listing and revoking the caller's own API tokens, with a password (HTTP Basic).

tags.name: Redirects
tags.description: A weblog's redirect rules: 301s for URLs that would otherwise 404.

tags.name: Members
tags.description: Who holds a role on a weblog. Reading is open to tokens; granting, changing and removing are session only (the admin app).

tags.name: Stylesheet
tags.description: A weblog's own stylesheet (session only: the admin app, never a token).

tags.name: User memberships
tags.description: Granting, changing and removing an account's roles on weblogs (session only: the admin app, never a token).

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: Agent accounts and the tokens minted for them (session only: the admin app, never a token).

tags.name: Entry actions
tags.description: Duplicate an entry into a new draft, or send it to the weblog's newsletter list. Needs publish rights, as the screens that do them do.

tags.name: Traffic
tags.description: A weblog's visitor figures, from the site's analytics.

tags.name: Audits
tags.description: Work lists for one weblog: entries with SEO gaps, and images without alt text.

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Reading a weblog's media files and directories. A contributor may, as the editor's image chooser shows them.

tags.name: Category writes
tags.description: Changing a weblog's categories: create, rename or describe, and delete. Needs publish rights, as the Categories page does.

tags.name: Meta
tags.description: Liveness, site facts, and who the caller is.

tags.name: Profile writes
tags.description: Changing the caller's own account and password (session only: the admin app, never a token).

tags.name: Site status
tags.description: What the Maintenance screen shows about front-page discovery and analytics, and the two actions beside it (site admins).

tags.name: Weblog business profiles
tags.description: The business profiles a weblog's owner may point the weblog at.

tags.name: Weblogs
tags.description: Every weblog on the site (site admins).

tags.name: Entry writes
tags.description: Writing entries: create, update, trash, preview, and restore or keep a revision. A member without publish rights writes drafts: a publish is submitted for review.

tags.name: Categories and tags
tags.description: Reading a weblog's categories and the tags its entries carry. A contributor may, as the entry editor shows them.

tags.name: Entries
tags.description: Reading a weblog's entries and their revisions.

tags.name: Site traffic
tags.description: Every blog's visitor figures, from the site's analytics (site admins).

tags.name: Maintenance
tags.description: The maintenance actions a site admin starts on one weblog: flush its page cache, rebuild its search index, regenerate its media renditions.

tags.name: Templates
tags.description: A weblog's own templates (session only: the admin app, never a token).

tags.name: Media writes
tags.description: Changing a weblog's media: upload, import from a URL, describe, move and delete files, and create directories. Needs publish rights, as the Media Files pages do.

tags.name: Weblog creation
tags.description: Creating a weblog; the caller becomes its owner.

exists.description: True when the weblog holds a stylesheet of its own.

customTheme.description: True when the weblog is on a custom theme, which owns its stylesheet.

sharedThemeStylesheet.description: True when the weblog's shared theme defines a stylesheet that can be copied.

contents.description: The stylesheet's CSS; absent when the weblog has none of its own.

entries.description: Ids of this blog's posts, in reading order: they become the strand's parts, replacing the whole list. An empty list removes every part. A post already in another strand is refused; move it with entries update strand.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of text, as hex. Send it back as expectedContentHash on update or on a revision restore so the change is refused if the page's text changed meanwhile.

trashedAt.description: When the page was moved to the trash; absent for a page that is not in it. Trashed pages are listed only by GET .../pages?status=TRASHED.

strand.description: True when the page is a strand: an ordered series of this blog's posts.

parts.description: A strand's parts, every member in order, drafts and the trash included; empty for a page that is not a strand. Change them with PUT .../pages/{id}/parts.

currentPassword.description: The account's current password: a signed-in session alone must not be enough to take the account over for good. Required.

newPassword.description: The new password, at least the minimum length. Required.

handle.description: The weblog's handle: its URL path. Letters and digits.

name.description: The weblog's name.

theme.description: A shared theme id, for example journal: required on create; on update it switches the blog to that theme. A wrong one answers with the ones offered. Custom themes are managed in the admin UI. Not clearable.

tagline.description: A line under the weblog's name.

copyright.description: The footer's copyright notice, plain text, at most 255 characters.

emailAddress.description: The weblog's contact email address. On create, defaults to the user's own.

locale.description: A locale such as en_US. On create, defaults to the user's own.

timeZone.description: A time zone id such as Europe/Berlin. On create, defaults to the user's own.

showMoreFromSite.description: Show the more-from-the-site block on this blog. Default true.

shareRowEnabled.description: Show the share row under this blog's posts. Default true.

entryOrder.description: NEWEST (the default) or OLDEST: the order of this blog's listings. Feeds stay newest first.

pageWidth.description: WIDE (the default) or STANDARD: STANDARD keeps the theme's narrower page and line length on large screens.

frontPage.description: Id of the published page shown at the blog's root; absent when the root lists posts (they then live at /posts).

editorTheme.description: The same value as theme, under its older name.

theme.description: The blog's theme: a shared theme id such as journal, or custom for a customised theme.

absoluteUrl.description: The weblog's absolute web address, as readers reach it (its custom domain when it has one); absent when it cannot be built.

importTheme.description: The id of the shared theme whose templates to import into the weblog; omit to switch with no import. Importing the weblog's current theme keeps a customised stylesheet.

id.description: The theme's id: what {@code theme} takes.

name.description: The theme's name.

description.description: What the theme looks like, in a sentence or two.

previewPath.description: Where the preview image is served, relative to the site root and starting with a slash ("/themes/journal/preview.png"); prefix the site's address. Absent when the theme has no preview.

current.description: The shared theme the weblog is on; absent when it is on a custom theme or its theme cannot be resolved.

custom.description: True when the weblog has its own templates (a custom theme): there is no way back.

customAllowed.description: True when the weblog may take a custom theme: the site allows them (or the weblog is already custom) and it is not the site space.

sharedStylesheetCustomised.description: True when a weblog on a shared theme holds its own copy of that theme's stylesheet.

firstCustomization.description: True when the weblog has no default page template yet, so a custom theme would be its first customisation.

themes.description: The shared themes this weblog may switch to, in the theme manager's order.

name.description: The template's name, at most 255 characters, unique in the weblog. Required.

action.description: What the template is for: one of the list's availableActions. Required.

name.description: The template's name.

action.description: WEBLOG, PERMALINK, SEARCH, TAGSINDEX, STYLESHEET or CUSTOM: what the template is for. Fixed once it exists.

description.description: What the template is for, in a sentence.

link.description: The path a custom template is served under.

navbar.description: True when a custom template is linked in the weblog's navigation bar.

hidden.description: True when a custom template is hidden from the weblog's public pages.

contentType.description: The output content type; absent when the engine chooses.

required.description: True for a template a custom theme requires, which cannot be removed.

contents.description: The template's markup; present when one template is read, not in the list.

source.description: The weblog-relative path to redirect, such as /old-path: no handle, no query string. Only a path that would otherwise 404 is ever redirected.

target.description: The weblog-relative path it answers with a 301, such as /new-path. Not off-site, and not itself redirected.

slug.description: The page's URL path segment: no slash, not a reserved name, unique in the weblog.

title.description: The page's title, as plain text.

status.description: DRAFT or PUBLISHED; a new page without one is a DRAFT.

showInNav.description: List the page in the blog's navigation.

navOrder.description: Position in the navigation, lowest first (0 or more; a negative number is refused); pages with the same number sort by title.

metaTitle.description: The search-result title: replaces the whole <title> and og:title. At most 60 characters, the length a search result shows; write one, not a copy of the title and not the title cut off: lead with the place or topic. Without one the page title is the title, plus the blog's name when that fits.

searchDescription.description: The meta description search engines and share previews show: one or two whole sentences, 50 to 160 characters (longer is cut off in a search result), saying what a reader will find.

canonicalUrl.description: An absolute http(s) URL this page canonicalises to, when it was first published elsewhere.

noindex.description: True asks search engines not to index the page. Not clearable.

ogImageId.description: Id of an image in this weblog's media, outside any private directory, used as the share image.

strand.description: True makes this page a strand: an ordered series of this blog's posts, listed beneath its text. Refused while it has parts if set false.

clear.description: On update, fields to remove: metaTitle, searchDescription, canonicalUrl, ogImageId. Null never removes anything.

revisionNote.description: On update, why the change was made; it labels the revision the update leaves when it changes the title or text. At most 255 characters.

expectedContentHash.description: On update and on a revision restore, the contentHash the page was read with. If the page's text is no longer that, the request is a 409 page-changed whose currentContentHash is the stored text's hash, and nothing is saved. Optional.

created.description: When the save that replaced this content was made.

creator.description: The user who made that save: the signed-in editor, or the API token's user.

note.description: Why that save was made, when it said: an update's revisionNote.

title.description: The entry's title as it was, as plain text like an entry's title.

kept.description: True when the revision is kept: exempt from every retention limit until released with .../unkeep. At most 10 per item.

expectedContentHash.description: On update and on a revision restore, the contentHash the page was read with. If the page's text is no longer that, the request is a 409 page-changed whose currentContentHash is the stored text's hash, and nothing is saved. Optional.

text.description: The text to render, in Markdown; absent renders an empty draft.

edits.description: Find/replace pairs applied to the entry's stored text, in order, each to the text as the previous ones left it: on update, and on preview with id. Each find must occur exactly once, or the request is refused naming every failing edit, and nothing is saved. At most 50; not with text. The result is saved as though sent as text (importExternalImages included).

featuredImageId.description: Ignored; accepted so older clients keep working. It served a warning about the body repeating the featured image, which no theme does any more.

find.description: Text of the entry, exactly as stored (get returns it), that must occur exactly once; include surrounding text until it does.

replace.description: What replaces it; an empty string deletes it.

userName.description: The user name of an existing, enabled account that is not a reader. Required.

screenName.description: The name the account is shown under.

kind.description: PERSON, or AGENT for an agent account.

permission.description: The strongest action the membership grants: ADMIN (manage the weblog and its members), POST (publish) or EDIT_DRAFT (write drafts, submitted for review).

description.description: What the file is, as the edit form's Description.

copyrightText.description: The copyright line, as the edit form's Copyright.

tags.description: The file's tags, sorted; never null.

x.description: Left edge of the crop, in pixels of the displayed image. Required.

y.description: Top edge of the crop, in pixels of the displayed image. Required.

width.description: Width of the crop in pixels; at least 1. Required.

height.description: Height of the crop in pixels; at least 1. Required.

expectedWidth.description: The file's width as media get reported it. When sent, the crop runs only if it still matches, so a retry cannot crop twice.

expectedHeight.description: The file's height as media get reported it; checked as expectedWidth is.

url.description: A public http or https URL of a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP image.

name.description: A name. On import, the image's file name; the extension follows the image's real type.

directoryId.description: A directory id. On import, defaults to the weblog's default directory.

name.description: The directory's name, unique in the weblog. Required.

title.description: The entry's title, as plain text in and out: send and receive "Tom & Jerry", never "Tom & Jerry". The server escapes it once for storage and unescapes it on every read, so a title read back can be sent back unchanged.

summary.description: A sentence or two shown under the title in lists of entries, and as the feed's summary. Markdown is accepted; lists show it as plain text. Without one, lists show the first couple of sentences of the text.

text.description: The entry's text, in Markdown. On update it replaces the whole text; not with edits.

status.description: DRAFT, PUBLISHED, PENDING or SCHEDULED; a new entry without one is a DRAFT. Without publish rights on the weblog, PUBLISHED and SCHEDULED are saved as PENDING, for review. TRASHED is not writable: trash, restore and delete-forever are their own calls.

category.description: The category's name, not its id. Omitted on create, the weblog's default category.

pubTime.description: Wall-clock publication time in the weblog's own timezone, for example 2026-03-01T09:30, or an instant with Z or an offset (2026-03-01T08:30:00Z, the form an entry is read back with). Publishing without one means now; SCHEDULED needs one.

tags.description: The entry's tags. On update, replaces the whole set.

metaTitle.description: The search-result title: replaces the whole <title> and og:title. At most 60 characters, the length a search result shows; write one, not a copy of the title and not the title cut off: lead with the place or topic. Without one the page title is the title, plus the blog's name when that fits.

searchDescription.description: The meta description search engines and share previews show: one or two whole sentences, 50 to 160 characters (longer is cut off in a search result), saying what a reader will find.

canonicalUrl.description: An absolute http(s) URL this entry canonicalises to, when it was first published elsewhere.

noindex.description: True asks search engines not to index the entry. Not clearable.

featuredImageId.description: Id of a media file in this weblog, used as the featured image.

ogImageId.description: Id of an image in this weblog's media, outside any private directory, used as the share image.

jsonLdType.description: Structured data the permalink emits beside BlogPosting: BLOG_POSTING (the default), TOURIST_ATTRACTION, TOURIST_TRIP, EVENT, FAQ_PAGE or TECH_ARTICLE (which makes the article block a TechArticle instead of a BlogPosting).

geoLatitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, -90 to 90. With TOURIST_ATTRACTION it is the place's geo; it also centres the entry's [map].

eventStart.description: With EVENT: the start, wall-clock time in the weblog's zone, for example 2026-08-02T19:30, or an instant such as 2026-08-02T17:30:00Z.

eventEnd.description: The end, in the same form; not before eventStart.

commentsClosed.description: True to stop new comments on this entry; existing ones stay. Not clearable.

anchor.description: The entry's URL slug: lower-case letters and digits in words joined by - or _, for example torrey-pines. On create it sets the slug, made from the title when omitted, and one another entry of the weblog holds, a trashed one included, answers 409; it cannot change after. entries get (GET .../entries/by-anchor/{anchor}) finds the entry by it.

featuredImageUrl.description: A public http(s) URL of a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP image to import as the featured image, in one call. An image already in the weblog's default directory with the same bytes is reused. Not with featuredImageId.

featuredImageAlt.description: Alt text for the image featuredImageUrl imports: what the picture shows, in a short phrase. Always send it with featuredImageUrl. It fills the file's alt text only when that has none.

importExternalImages.description: Import every image the text loads from another site (HTML img src and Markdown images, at most 10) and point the text at the copies. Default: on, best effort, when the write sends text or edits: an image that cannot be copied stays linked and the write saves. False keeps linking. True is all or nothing: if any image fails, the entry is not written (images already imported stay and a retry reuses them); with no text on an update it imports from the stored text. With no featured image, the first picture becomes it.

clear.description: On update, fields to remove: summary, metaTitle, searchDescription, canonicalUrl, featuredImageId, ogImageId, jsonLdType (back to BLOG_POSTING), geoLatitude with geoLongitude, eventStart, eventEnd, eventLocation, strand (out of its strand). Null never removes anything.

edits.description: Find/replace pairs applied to the entry's stored text, in order, each to the text as the previous ones left it: on update, and on preview with id. Each find must occur exactly once, or the request is refused naming every failing edit, and nothing is saved. At most 50; not with text. The result is saved as though sent as text (importExternalImages included).

expectedContentHash.description: On update and on a revision restore, the contentHash the entry was read with. When the stored text's hash differs, someone changed the entry since: the request is a 409 entry-changed whose currentContentHash is the stored text's hash, and nothing is saved. Get the entry again and redo the change. Without it, the write overwrites whatever is stored.

revisionNote.description: On update, why this change is made, at most 255 characters, for example "Shorten the intro". It labels, in the entry's revision list, the revision the update leaves: the content it replaced. An update that changes no title, text or summary leaves no revision, and its note is dropped. Not on create.

pinned.description: True to pin this entry to the top of its blog's home listing; at most 3 per blog. Needs publish rights.

strand.description: Id of one of this blog's strand pages: the entry joins it as the last part. clear: ["strand"] takes it out. Needs publish rights.

locale.description: The entry's locale, at most 20 characters, for example en_US. Omitted on create, the weblog's locale; blank on update is the same. Not clearable.

pinnedToMain.description: True to pin this entry to the site's main page. Needs a site administrator. Not clearable.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the stored text (UTF-8), lower-case hex. Send it back as expectedContentHash on update so the update is refused if the entry changed meanwhile.

pinned.description: True when the entry is pinned to the top of its blog's home listing.

strand.description: Id of the strand page this entry is a part of; absent when it is in none.

locale.description: The entry's locale, for example en_US; a new entry without one has its weblog's.

pinnedToMain.description: True when the entry is pinned to the site's main page (a site administrator's setting).

newsletterSentAt.description: When the entry was sent as a newsletter; absent until it has been (see POST .../entries/{id}/send-newsletter).

trashedAt.description: When the entry was moved to the trash; absent for an entry that is not in it. Trashed entries are listed only by GET .../entries?status=TRASHED.

views30d.description: Page views over the last 30 days, as the entries page's Views (30d) column. Only a list asked for it with fields=views30d carries it (it costs one analytics read per list), and only when analytics is configured and the count is known: an entry with no recorded views is a known 0 once the blog has a complete snapshot, and absent before that.

expectedContentHash.description: On update and on a revision restore, the contentHash the entry was read with. When the stored text's hash differs, someone changed the entry since: the request is a 409 entry-changed whose currentContentHash is the stored text's hash, and nothing is saved. Get the entry again and redo the change. Without it, the write overwrites whatever is stored.

body.description: The reply's text, written as the token's user and published at once; at most 4000 characters.

name.description: The category's name, unique in the weblog. Required on create.

image.description: An icon for the category: an absolute http or https URL, at most 255 characters. Blank on update removes it.
The category's icon: an absolute http or https URL; absent when it has none.

label.description: A name for the token, so its owner can tell it from the others.

weblog.description: The handle of the one weblog the token may act on; omitted, every weblog its user can reach.

role.description: READ, POST or ADMIN: what the token may do.

expiresAt.description: When the token stops working, an ISO-8601 instant in the future; omitted, it works until revoked.

action.description: flush-cache, rebuild-index or regenerate-renditions: the action started.

weblog.description: The handle of the weblog it was started on.

userName.description: The account's user name, which it signs in with; it never changes.

emailAddress.description: The account's email address; the set-password link is sent to it.

fullName.description: The account's full name. Defaults to the screen name.

locale.description: The account's locale, one the settings form offers, for example en_US.

timeZone.description: The account's time zone id, for example Europe/Berlin.

password.description: Session only (SA-18). A password for the account to sign in with at once, instead of a set-password link; the account is then created enabled and no mail is needed.

administrator.description: Session only (SA-18). Give the new account the site administrator role.

locale.description: The account's locale, for example en_US.

timeZone.description: The account's time zone id, for example Europe/Berlin.

writer.description: Whether the account holds the editor (author) role. Settable only on a single-sign-on account.

handle.description: The handle of an existing weblog (never the site space). Required.

name.description: The weblog's name; an empty string when it has none.

permission.description: ADMIN, POST or EDIT_DRAFT: the highest permission the account holds on it.

dryRun.description: False runs the sweep and removes revisions. True, or no body at all, only reports what it would remove.

state.description: DISABLED (no analytics to read), NEVER (not read yet), OK or FAILED.

lastAttempt.description: When the last refresh was tried.

candidates.description: Entries eligible for the front page.

lastError.description: Why the last refresh failed, when it did.

name.description: The business's name, at most 255 characters. Required on create; never cleared.

businessType.description: The schema.org type: Organization, LocalBusiness or ProfessionalService. Defaults to Organization on create; never cleared.

websiteUrl.description: A public http or https URL, at most 255 characters.

bookingUrl.description: Where the business is booked: a public http or https URL, at most 255 characters.

telephone.description: Digits, plus, parentheses, hyphen, dot and space, optionally an extension such as "ext. 89"; 3 to 32 characters.

email.description: An email address, at most 255 characters.

logoUrl.description: The logo's public http or https URL, at most 255 characters.

sameAs.description: Profile links, each a public http or https URL of at most 255 characters; at most 10. Replaces the whole list.

areaServed.description: The area the business serves, at most 255 characters.

clear.description: Fields to remove: websiteUrl, bookingUrl, telephone, email, logoUrl, sameAs, areaServed, description. Updates only. Null never removes anything.

id.description: The business's id; a weblog's businessId names it.

name.description: The business's name.

businessType.description: The schema.org type: Organization, LocalBusiness or ProfessionalService.

bookingUrl.description: Where the business is booked, or null.

telephone.description: The business's telephone number, or null.

email.description: The business's email address, or null.

logoUrl.description: The URL of the business's logo, or null.

description.description: What the business does, or null.

weblogCount.description: How many weblogs use this business.

lastModified.description: When the business was last saved.

configured.description: Whether an analytics service is set up.

reachable.description: Whether the last call reached it; absent before any call.

failures.description: The weblogs that failed to register.

lastReadError.description: Why the last read failed, when it did.

userName.description: The agent's user name; letters and digits, it never changes. Required.

name.description: The agent's name, stored as screen name and full name. Required.

emailAddress.description: An optional email address; blank leaves the store's placeholder.

notes.description: Notes about what the agent is for.

siteAdmin.description: Give the agent the site administrator role. Default false.

userName.description: The agent's user name, which never changes.

name.description: The agent's name: its screen name and full name.

emailAddress.description: The agent's email address; the store fills one in when none was given.

notes.description: Notes about what the agent is for.

enabled.description: Whether the agent may act; disabling ends every one of its tokens on its next request.

siteAdmin.description: Whether the agent holds the site administrator role, for the site-wide admin API.

tokens.description: The agent's live tokens, newest first. Only on a single agent's read.

name.description: The weblog's name.

tagline.description: A line under the weblog's name. Remove with clear.

copyright.description: The footer's copyright notice, plain text, at most 255 characters. Remove with clear.

timeZone.description: A time zone id such as Europe/Berlin.

entryDisplayCount.description: How many entries a page of the weblog shows: at least 1, at most the site's limit.

customDomain.description: A hostname the weblog is served at, such as blog.example.com; an empty string or clear removes it.

icon.description: The path of the weblog's icon image, at most 255 characters. Remove with clear.

about.description: A short text about this weblog, at most 255 characters. Remove with clear.

newsletterListUuid.description: The UUID of the newsletter list readers subscribe to. Remove with clear.

businessId.description: Id of an existing business profile

placeLocality.description: The place's town or city, at most 128 characters

placeRegion.description: The place's region, at most 128 characters

placeLat.description: Decimal degrees, given as a pair; stored to two decimals

placeLng.description: Decimal degrees, given as a pair; stored to two decimals

bookingUrl.description: An http or https URL where the place is booked, at most 255 characters

commentsEnabled.description: Allow signed-in readers to comment. Not clearable.

commentNotify.description: Email the owners when a comment needs approval. Not clearable.

showMoreFromSite.description: Show popular posts from the site's other blogs on this blog. Not clearable.

shareRowEnabled.description: Show the share row under this blog's posts. Not clearable.

entryOrder.description: NEWEST or OLDEST (any case): the order of this blog's listings. Feeds stay newest first. Not clearable.

pageWidth.description: WIDE or STANDARD (any case): STANDARD keeps the theme's narrower page and line length on large screens. Not clearable.

frontPage.description: Id of a published page of this blog to show at its root; the post list then moves to /posts. Remove with clear.

theme.description: A shared theme id, for example journal: required on create; on update it switches the blog to that theme. A wrong one answers with the ones offered. Custom themes are managed in the admin UI. Not clearable.

name.description: A custom template's name; ignored for the other kinds, as the form does.

navbar.description: Whether a custom template is linked in the navigation bar.

hidden.description: Whether a custom template is hidden from the public pages.

contentType.description: The output content type; empty string lets the engine choose.

altText.description: Alt text for the image; an empty string marks it decorative. Remove with clear.

focalX.description: The focal point's left-to-right position, a fraction of the width from 0 to 1. A file has both coordinates or neither.

focalY.description: The focal point's top-to-bottom position, a fraction of the height from 0 to 1.

directoryId.description: A directory id: moves the file there.

name.description: The file's name; not blank.

description.description: What the file is; at most 255 characters. Remove with clear.

tags.description: Replaces the file's whole tag set; each tag at most 30 characters. Tags split on spaces and commas as the edit form's do; an empty list removes them all.

isPrivate.description: Whether the directory is private: hidden from every public surface, visible to the weblog's members. Required.

status.description: On update: PUBLISHED or HIDDEN, the only statuses a comment can be set to.

screenName.description: The display name that signs the account's comments and posts.

posts.description: The most viewed entries across the blogs, most viewed first.

sources.description: The site's top sources; a source several blogs share shows the largest single blog's visitors, so the value is a lower bound.

id.description: The token's id; what revoking it takes.

label.description: The label its owner gave it.

scopeWeblog.description: The weblog it is limited to; absent when it reaches every weblog its owner can.

owner.description: The user name of the account the token acts as.

ownerKind.description: PERSON or AGENT: what kind of account the owner is.

issuedBy.description: The user name of whoever issued it (the stored id when that account is gone); absent on a token issued before issuers were recorded.

kind.description: ENTRY or PAGE: whose revisions these are.

name.description: The group's name.

key.description: The message key of its heading.

name.description: The property's name, as GET and PATCH /v1/admin/config use it.

key.description: The message key of its label.

type.description: string, text, boolean, integer or float; anything else is edited as a string.

defaultValue.description: The value used while none is stored.

rows.description: Rows of the text box for a text property.

cols.description: Columns of the text box for a text property.

offset.description: How many items before this page were skipped: the offset asked for.

limit.description: The page size asked for, after the cap of 200.

hasMore.description: True while items remain beyond this page: page until it is false, not until a short page arrives.

total.description: How many business profiles the site has, across every page.

offset.description: How many items before this page were skipped: the offset asked for.

limit.description: The page size asked for, after the cap of 200.

hasMore.description: True while items remain beyond this page: page until it is false, not until a short page arrives.

ApiProblem.description: Why a request failed: an RFC 9457 problem detail, served as application/problem+json. Branch on code, never on detail.

type.description: The problem's coarse category, as a URI.

title.description: The category's short English name. Not localised.

detail.description: What went wrong, for a person to read; in the Accept-Language language when the server has it. Never branch on it.

instance.description: The path of the request that failed.

errors.description: One entry per field the request got wrong, when the problem names fields.

currentContentHash.description: On an entry-changed or page-changed 409: the hash of the text now stored, which the request's expectedContentHash did not match.

code.description: A stable, case-sensitive code to branch on, refining type. Codes are never renamed or removed, but new ones are added: treat one you do not know by its type and status.

field.description: The request field at fault; absent when the problem names no field the request sent.

message.description: What is wrong with it, for a person to read. Never branch on it.

code.description: A stable, case-sensitive code to branch on, refining type. Codes are never renamed or removed, but new ones are added: treat one you do not know by its type and status.
